messages:
maya: Heads up — running a 45m pre-QBR playtest tomorrow to stress-test MDF scenarios across Cloud Marketplace, HW partners, and SI bundles. Goal: pick 3 budget scenarios and map downstream scorecard changes.
jon: +1. Can we get the finance model ahead of time? want to run sensitivity on discount tiers.
liam: I can drop a draft scorecard template in the thread later today. we should validate partner tier triggers (revenue, joint pipeline, PS enablement).
anita: adding marketplace uplift numbers from last quarter: link https://redwood.cloud/reports/marketplace-uplift-q4 — there was a 22% increase in new SI-led installs after the joint writeup.
rachel: would be useful to include a baseline for HW partner credits (we’ve seen big variance by SKU).
jon: thanks anita. rachel — can you pop the HW credit ranges into a quick table? i’ll wire them into the model.
rachel: sure. pasted quick ranges below:
```
HW credit band | monthly commit | expected uplift
Small (S1) | $5k | 8-12%
Medium (M2) | $25k | 15-22%
Large (L3) | $100k | 25-40%
```
liam: perfect, thanks. for the playtest agenda: 1) scenario walkthrough 2) scorecard delta mapping 3) roll-forward actions 4) owner assignments. can we invite product + go-to-market leads?
maya: yes — invite list: @anita @rachel @jon @liam + @sara (prod) + @kevin (gtm). partnership-bot: calendar invite created: "Partner Program: MDF Scenario Playtest" tomorrow 10:00-10:45 PT. :calendar:.
jon: quick ask — will we model the canary rollback for tier promotions? last QBR that bit us.
liam: include a canary policy column in the scorecard. sample: `canary: 2-week trial on 1% of partner deals, auto-rollback if uplift < threshold`
anita: also: flag any joint announcements that need legal review if MDF > $50k. past vendors slowed on approvals.
maya: noted. i'll add legal gate to the runbook.
rachel: for SI integrations, we should map activation metrics (first flow, integration success rate) to tier eligibility — not just revenue.
liam: agreed. add activation metrics: integration success >= 85% and first-flow within 30 days.
jon: finance note: we should produce 3 budget scenarios: conservative (0.8x), base (1x), growth (1.4x) relative to last quarter spend. i'll attach the csv after lunch.
maya: great. owners: jon (financial model), liam (scorecards), rachel (hardware ranges), anita (marketplace uplift + comms), maya (runbook + legal gate).
liam: i'll seed the scorecard with columns: partner_id, tier, revenue_last_12m, joint_pipeline, activation_rate, canary_policy, mdf_credits_allocated, go_forward_action_owner.
anita: quick comms note — if we do a joint announcement as part of a growth scenario, we need a 3-week lead time for press and partner ops.
maya: adding that to rollout timeline.
jon: uploaded draft model: https://drive.redwood/fin/qbr-mdf-scenarios.csv
rachel: looked at model — question on attribution: are we attributing marketplace leads to partner or to redwood first-touch? that changes uplift math.
liam: propose dual-attribution column (marketplace_claimed_by, redwood_claimed_by) so we can reconcile.
maya: good call. final ask: please drop any redlines or blockers before EOD so we can finalize slides for the QBR deck.
liam: will do.
anita: sending a short partner comms checklist in 15.
partnership-bot: Reminder: QBR slide deadline in 48 hours.
maya: thanks all. see you in the playtest. :coffee:
